reader.requirement: At --std 85, data description entries in the Working-Storage and Linkage Sections must carry level-number 01 through 49 (1-9 may be written 01-09), 66, 77 or 88, and any other level-number (00, 50-65, 67-76, 78-87, 89-99) must be refused in both sections.
reader.edition-search: Read LevelNumberPass.cs whole: LevelNumberRules.Table, Classify (section ancestry: WorkingStorageSection/LocalStorageSection/LinkageSection -> NoncontiguousCapable, specials [66,77,88]) and VisitLevelNumber carry no EditionContext, CobolVersion, ConstructRegistry or DialectBehavior reference; the class remarks state the pass is deliberately not edition-gated because the sets are the same in every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb485_level_number_legal_forms covers the legal forms; the probes add the refusal half in both sections (00, 50, 55, 65, 67, 76, 78, 89, 99)

reader.notes: One table row (NoncontiguousCapable) serves WS and Linkage at every edition and matches the 1985 set exactly. The out-of-range entries draw cascade diagnostics (COBOL2771, COBOL2191) after the COBOL1746 refusal, but the rule's refusal is present and first for each.
